description:
The Contract Khel Prashikshakon Ki Niyukti scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2021. 

This scheme is part of the broader initiative to promote sports and physical education in the country. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to appoint sports coaches on a contractual basis in various educational institutions. 

The government aims to enhance the quality of sports training provided to students across schools and colleges. 

The scheme specifically targets the recruitment of qualified coaches to ensure that students receive proper training in various sports disciplines. 

The initiative is expected to improve the overall sports infrastructure and promote a culture of physical fitness among the youth. 

The scheme also aims to create job opportunities for trained sports professionals. 

Under this scheme, the government has set a target to appoint approximately 10,000 coaches across different states and union territories. 

The recruitment process is designed to be transparent and merit-based. 

Coaches appointed under this scheme will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹25,000. 

This amount is intended to provide a sustainable livelihood for the coaches while they contribute to the development of sports in educational institutions. 

The eligibility criteria for applicants include a minimum educational qualification of a Bachelor's degree in Physical Education or a related field. 

Candidates must also possess a valid coaching certification from recognized sports bodies. 

The age limit for applicants is set between 21 years and 40 years. 

This age criterion ensures that the coaches are young enough to engage effectively with students. 

The application process involves several steps to ensure that only qualified candidates are selected. 

Interested candidates must fill out an online application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. 

They are required to submit scanned copies of their educational qualifications and coaching certifications along with the application. 

The application window is open for a period of 30 days from the date of announcement of the recruitment drive. 

After the application submission period closes, a merit list will be published based on the qualifications and experience of the applicants. 

Shortlisted candidates will then be called for an interview conducted by a selection committee. 

The selection committee will consist of representatives from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and experienced sports professionals. 

Successful candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis for a period of two years. 

The contract may be renewed based on performance evaluations conducted at the end of the contract period. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in collaboration with state sports departments. 

Each state is responsible for the recruitment process and management of the coaches appointed under this scheme. 

The Ministry provides guidelines and support to ensure uniformity in the recruitment process across states. 

The disbursement of salaries to the appointed coaches is managed through the respective state sports departments. 

Payments are made on a monthly basis directly to the bank accounts of the coaches. 

The scheme also includes provisions for training and professional development of the appointed coaches. 

Regular workshops and training sessions will be organized to update coaches on the latest coaching techniques and sports science. 

This initiative is expected to lead to an increase in student participation in sports at the school and college levels. 

The government aims to foster a competitive spirit among students through enhanced coaching. 

The scheme is also aligned with the National Sports Policy of 2009, which emphasizes the importance of sports in education. 

The implementation of this scheme is expected to contribute to India's performance in international sports events. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹500 crores for the implementation of this scheme over the next five years. 

This budget will cover the salaries of coaches as well as the costs associated with training and development programs. 

The scheme is expected to benefit not only the coaches but also thousands of students across the country. 

By providing access to qualified coaching, the government aims to improve the skill levels of young athletes. 

The initiative is also expected to promote inclusivity in sports by encouraging participation from diverse backgrounds. 

The scheme will be monitored regularly to assess its impact on sports education and student engagement. 

Feedback from educational institutions and coaches will be collected to make necessary adjustments to the program. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the Contract Khel Prashikshakon Ki Niyukti scheme meets its objectives effectively. 

This commitment is reflected in the continuous support and resources allocated for the development of sports in India. 

The scheme is part of a larger vision to make India a sporting nation and to encourage a healthy lifestyle among its citizens. 

The government recognizes the role of sports in nation-building and community development. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a robust framework for sports coaching in educational institutions. 

The Contract Khel Prashikshakon Ki Niyukti scheme represents a significant step towards professionalizing sports coaching in India. 

It is expected to have a lasting impact on the sports culture in the country. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the government's commitment to promoting sports and physical education. 

It aims to empower young athletes and provide them with the necessary resources to excel in their chosen sports. 

The initiative is also expected to inspire a new generation of sports enthusiasts and professionals. 

Overall, the Contract Khel Prashikshakon Ki Niyukti scheme is a comprehensive approach to enhancing sports education in India. 

It combines recruitment, training, and development to create a sustainable sports ecosystem in the country. 

The government is optimistic that this scheme will lead to significant improvements in the quality of sports coaching and athlete performance. 

As the scheme progresses, it will be crucial to evaluate its effectiveness and make adjustments as needed. 

The future of sports in India looks promising with the implementation of initiatives like the Contract Khel Prashikshakon Ki Niyukti scheme.
